decisions.rationale: The author asks the recipient to deliver and pack the replicas.

decisions.rationale: The author unconditionally asserts future delivery by their team.
evidence: Our pest monitoring team will provide the grain store manager with the completed moth trap count chart tomorrow.

decisions.rationale: Delivery is tentative and conditional on successful curing.
